author: SickProdigy
description: Generate memes with the Imgflip API.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users. Meme template IDs and submitted caption text are sent to the Imgflip API to generate images.
install_msg: Set Imgflip credentials with `[p]imgflipset`, then use `[p]meme <template> <text>` to generate memes. Use `[p]getmemes` to browse popular templates.
name: Imgflip
